definitions.explanation: A flat mat woven from rushes (igusa) or similar plant materials. Used for sitting or lying on outdoors, at festivals, picnics, and traditional events. Also refers to the woven surface layer of tatami.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ござ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}いた→敷く：00366_shiku⟧。
examples.english: I spread out a mat for cherry blossom viewing.

examples.japanese: ござ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}って→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I sat on the rush mat and ate my boxed lunch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏祭|なつまつ}り→夏祭り：09871_natsumatsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ござ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何枚|なんまい}→何枚：08777_nanmai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{並|なら}べられていた→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: Many rush mats were laid out at the summer festival venue.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly associated with outdoor events like ⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧ (cherry blossom viewing), ⟦{花火大会|はなびたいかい}→花火大会：10105_hanabitaikai⟧ (fireworks festivals), and picnics. The word can also refer to the woven rush surface of ⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧, known as ござ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ござ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧ (to spread out a mat)
- ござ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧ (on the mat)
- ⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧ござ (cherry blossom viewing mat)

WRITING:
Sometimes written as {茣蓙|ござ}, but the kana form is far more common in modern usage.
